# Misty Fly

Misty Fly, nicknamed **Dizzy** by her teammates, is a veteran Pegasus mare in the Wonderbolts in G4 *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is one of the three Wonderbolts Rainbow Dash saves in her first successful on-screen sonic rainboom.

[![Misty Fly (right) with Fleetfoot — Newbie Dash, Hasbro/DHX Media](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2021/4/20/2387391__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_fleetfoot_misty%2Bfly_pegasus_pony_newbie%2Bdash_clothes_female_goggles_image_mare_png_uniform_wonderbolts%2Bunifor.png)](https://twibooru.org/2387391)

**Appearance:** Pale yellow coat, swept-back two-tone cyan mane and tail, green eyes and the blue-and-yellow Wonderbolt uniform. Her cutie mark depicts blue mist and two orange butterflies; it is partially visible in *Grannies Gone Wild*. See the [MLP Vector Club color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/137-Misty-Fly).

**Names:** Early fans reportedly called her Misty and Ice Wind. Hasbro released her as Misty Fly in its January 2013 Wave 7 blind bags; Soarin first addresses her by that name on television in *Rarity Investigates!* (2015). Icy Mist is an alternate merchandise name, not a separate character. [Toy history](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Misty_Fly).

**Voice and appearances:** A recurring speaking supporting character, credited to Kelly Sheridan in the [season-six credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six). Other appearances include *The Best Night Ever*, *Sweet and Elite*, *Parental Glideance*, *Grannies Gone Wild*, *The Washouts*, *The Ending of the End — Part 2* and *The Last Problem*. She also appears in Gameloft's mobile game and is mentioned on the IDW *Friends Forever* #18 cover. [Character and appearance reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Misty_Fly).

[![Misty Fly fan vector by Philipp04 — earlier blue-eyed interpretation](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/12/318819__safe_artist-colon-philipp04_derpibooru%2Bimport_misty%2Bfly_pegasus_pony_blue%2Beyes_clothes_female_mare_simple%2Bbackground_solo_transparent%2Bbackgroun.png)](https://twibooru.org/posts/318819)

## Important moments

- **Attempted rescue — Sonic Rainboom (S1E16):** She dives after the falling Rarity, is knocked unconscious, and is saved alongside Spitfire and Soarin by Rainbow Dash. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sonic_Rainboom); timestamp unavailable.
- **Searching for Spitfire — Rarity Investigates! (S5E15):** Misty questions Rainbow Dash's motives and is then assigned with Blaze to locate the missing captain. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Rarity_Investigates%21); timestamp unavailable.
- **Revealing her nickname — Newbie Dash (S6E7):** Misty admits that she is called Dizzy, helping Rainbow Dash understand that embarrassing nicknames are shared by the entire team. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q3nh6bSauu0); timestamp unavailable.
- **Called back to duty — Top Bolt (S6E24):** She interrupts Rainbow Dash's long-awaited time off to summon her back to headquarters for an emergency. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Top_Bolt); timestamp unavailable.
